about: Expected changes between two releases of the labels, for scripts/48_compare_labels.py. Each entry is dated and points to the dated note that decided it. A difference between two label sets passes only if it is a remake difference the script always allows (source fingerprints, the commit and time that made the label) or exactly one of these changes: the same field or rendered text, from exactly the old text to exactly the new text. Entries are added, never edited or removed.

changes.note: docs/label_schema.md, note of 5 October 2026 (H's fix list of 4 October 2026, item 1)
changes.what: ImageNet-C limit sentence: no longer says the conditions were made with the official corruption code
changes.old: The ImageNet-C conditions were made with the official corruption code on these test images, with fixed seeds and each model's own preprocessing, so they are not directly comparable to published ImageNet-C results.
changes.new: The ImageNet-C conditions were made on these test images with the imagecorruptions package v1.1.2 (an extension of the ImageNet-C code), with a one-line fix so that fog runs on NumPy 2, tested pixel-identical to the unmodified package's fog. Fixed seeds and each model's own preprocessing were used, so the results are not directly comparable to the released ImageNet-C files or to published ImageNet-C results.

changes.note: docs/label_schema.md, note of 5 October 2026 (H's fix list of 4 October 2026, item 1)
changes.what: glossary line "Brokkr and ImageNet-C": no longer says the damage was made with ImageNet-C's official code
changes.old: the two sets of damage: Brokkr's own, and ImageNet-C, a widely used public benchmark (made here with its official code).
changes.new: the two sets of damage: Brokkr's own, and ImageNet-C, a widely used public benchmark. Its damage types were made here with the imagecorruptions package (an extension of the ImageNet-C code), not taken from the released ImageNet-C files; see the limits.
